1. 4100 Project and implementation revenue rose $57.5k to $96,400, up 147.8 percent, on the Riverbend cutover that ran the whole month (source: project billing schedule).
2. Project and implementation revenue carries the final Riverbend milestone, which was billed on 31 July and accepted the same day (source: signed acceptance certificate).
3. 5000 Subcontracted engineering fell $46,500 to $88,300 as the cutover was staffed through two partner firms (source: partner invoices on file).
4. 6000 Salaries and wages held flat at $88,500, with no headcount movement in the month (source: payroll register).
5. 6200 Software licences and hosting rose $25,300 to $57,900 on the annual renewal of the monitoring platform, billed in July (source: vendor invoice).
6. 6400 Client acquisition costs rose $9,300, or 189.8 percent, which fails the dollar leg of the threshold, so this line carries no driver.
